name: arcade-mcp
summary: Arcade's open-source Python framework for building MCP servers and tools, with authorized tool calling (OAuth, token refresh) and tool-call evals.
description: Decorator API covering tools, resources, prompts, sampling, elicitation, progress and logging; `requires_auth=...` lets Arcade handle OAuth so the client and LLM never see tokens. Vendor-neutral across MCP clients and agent frameworks; includes `arcade evals`.
